hero.subtext: An elevated celebration of Nigerian and West African cuisine — slow-cooked soups, smoky grills, and the warmth of a table that feels like family.

about.heading: Authentically Nigerian, unapologetically premium
paragraphs: Festac Grill & Lounge began with a simple promise — that the flavors of home should never be diluted to travel. Every pot of egusi, every grain of jollof, is built the long, patient way: stock simmered for hours, peppers ground fresh, fish smoked over open flame.
From our kitchen in Brooklyn, we plate the dishes of Lagos buka spots and Sunday family tables alike, elevated for a dining room that honors the craft behind the cuisine.

testimonials.name: Adaeze O.
testimonials.text: The egusi tasted exactly like home. Service was warm, the lounge felt elegant without being stiff.

testimonials.name: Marcus T.
testimonials.text: Best suya I've had outside Lagos. The jollof had that real smoky flavor — clearly made with care.

testimonials.name: Funmi A.
testimonials.text: We booked the private table for a birthday and it was flawless. Isiewu and nkwobi disappeared in minutes.
